items.title: DeFranco Buddy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I taught he and, for a short time, Steve Botek

ctx.x: You mentioned Ron Aldrich, who was one of your very few students. You haven’t really taught many, you have chosen not to teach people.

No. I taught he and, for a short time, Steve Botek, who is a psychiatrist now and has been for several years, and a good clarinetist, he doesn’t play that much anymore. But I taught Ronnie for almost a year.
And why just those two guys? I’m sure you had a lot of people coming to you asking for lessons.
